description: Paraphrased, dated facts checked against the linked 2025 company annual reports; pilot only.

passages.title: Reliance consolidated value of sales and services FY2024-25
passages.text: For the year ended 31 March 2025, consolidated value of sales and services was INR 10,71,174 crore; the FY2023-24 comparator was INR 10,00,122 crore. These are before subtracting GST recovered.
passages.locator: Consolidated statement of profit and loss, printed page 197

passages.title: Reliance consolidated revenue from operations FY2024-25
passages.text: After GST recovered, consolidated revenue from operations for the year ended 31 March 2025 was INR 9,80,136 crore; FY2023-24 was INR 9,14,472 crore. This differs from value of sales and services.
passages.locator: Consolidated statement of profit and loss, printed page 197

passages.title: Reliance consolidated operating cash flow FY2024-25
passages.text: Consolidated net cash flow from operating activities was INR 1,78,703 crore in FY2024-25 versus INR 1,58,788 crore in FY2023-24.
passages.locator: Consolidated statement of cash flows, printed page 201

passages.title: Reliance consolidated borrowings at March 2025
passages.text: The financing-liability reconciliation lists total borrowings of INR 3,47,530 crore at 31 March 2025, comprising INR 2,66,222 crore non-current borrowings including current maturities and INR 81,308 crore current borrowings.
passages.locator: Cash-flow notes and change in financing liabilities, printed page 201

passages.title: Microsoft FY2025 consolidated revenue
passages.text: For the year ended 30 June 2025, total revenue was USD 281,724 million, compared with USD 245,122 million in FY2024.
passages.locator: 2025 annual report, consolidated statements of income

passages.title: Microsoft FY2025 operating income
passages.text: Operating income was USD 128,528 million for FY2025 and USD 109,433 million for FY2024.

passages.title: Microsoft FY2025 operating cash
passages.text: Net cash from operations was USD 136,162 million in FY2025, compared with USD 118,548 million in FY2024.
passages.locator: 2025 annual report, consolidated statements of cash flows

passages.title: Microsoft June 2025 debt
passages.text: At 30 June 2025, total debt was USD 43,151 million and long-term debt excluding the current portion was USD 40,152 million.
